# Project: Ledger

## Stack
- python 3.12
- sqlite

## Forbidden
- network calls at import time

## NFRs
- p95 latency under 200 ms


## Project Rules (MUST follow)

- Money is integer cents, never float.

## Prior Architecture Decisions (stay consistent; do NOT re-litigate)

# ADR US-0000: storage

- Status: approved by operator

Use sqlite.

## Design under review

{
  "verdict": "pass",

## Why this design needs a boundary review

- it changes an API
- it touches sensitive areas (financial)

Review the design's tenant, authorization, API-contract and security boundaries BEFORE any code is written, and emit your sub-verdicts as JSON.
